notes: Supplementary prior-art challengers and simplicity controls. Datasets, splits, seeds, Track B parameters, and primary baselines remain bitwise identical to bench_01_locked_config.json.

supplementary_challengers.name: Variable-Tap Length LMS (Zhao et al. 2008)
supplementary_challengers.scientific_role: Tests whether Track B capacity adaptation exceeds classical adaptive-filter order selection on linear/delayed streams.

supplementary_challengers.name: Linear Recurrent Unit Streaming Adaptation (Orvieto et al. 2023)
supplementary_challengers.scientific_role: Tests whether simple compact fixed learned linear recurrent state matches Track B without dynamic lifecycle.

supplementary_challengers.name: Recurrent Self-Organizing Neural Network (Neurocomputing 2017)
supplementary_challengers.scientific_role: Direct prior-art challenge to online recurrent structural growth, pruning, and resource adaptation.

supplementary_challengers.name: Adaptive Compression Echo State Network (Zhang et al. 2026)
supplementary_challengers.scientific_role: Tests whether physical state creation/destruction buys anything over exposed-dimension capacity scheduling.

supplementary_challengers.name: Continual Backpropagation (Dohare et al. Nature 2024)
supplementary_challengers.scientific_role: Mechanistic comparator testing whether maturity + utility replacement alone explain Track-B behavior.

supplementary_challengers.name: SkipE-RNN (Evolving RNN with Skip Connections)
supplementary_challengers.scientific_role: Excluded from execution due to absence of verified streaming regression reference implementation; documented fidelity risk.
